### Primaquine regimens by G6PD status

| G6PD category | Radical-cure treatment policy | Treatment implementation | Follow-up approach | Follow-up implementation |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| **G6PD normal: no definition** | PQ 0.25 mg/kg/day over 14 days | Not implemented | In patient - blood films everyday to confirm drug efficacy/parasite clearance; for primary care, patients are asked to return to the health facility on day 3, 7, 14, 21, 28 and provided with counselling while their urine color is monitored | Partially implemented |
| **G6PD normal: no definition - relapse** | PQ 0.5 mg/kg/day over 14 days | Not implemented | In patient - blood films everyday to confirm drug efficacy/parasite clearance; for primary care, patients are asked to return to the health facility on day 3, 7, 14, 21, 28 and provided with counselling while their urine color is monitored | Partially implemented |
| **G6PD deficient: no definition** | No PQ |  | In patient - blood films everyday to confirm drug efficacy/parasite clearance; for primary care, patients are asked to return to the health facility on day 3, 7, 14, 21, 28 and provided with counselling while their urine color is monitored | Partially implemented |
| **If no testing available** | Not specified but PQ 0.25 mg/kg/day over 14 days in practice | Implemented | In patient - blood films everyday to confirm drug efficacy/parasite clearance; for primary care, patients are asked to return to the health facility on day 3, 7, 14, 21, 28 and provided with counselling while their urine color is monitored | Partially implemented |

### Country-specific policy context

<div class="country-policy-context">In the three high-burden areas, G6PD testing will be rolled out with high dose 7-day PQ. The plan is for rollout of G6PD testing in 2027 up to the health centre level. G6PD normal will receive the &quot;optimal&quot; dose, intermediates will received 0.5 mg/kg/day over 14 days, deficient provided 8 week. Follow up of patients will remain the same. In 2006, higher dosage for relapse cases was added to the guidelines. Certain areas of Indonesia with higher relapse rates e.g. used the higher dosage of 0.5 mg/kg/day over 14 days as a stantard.</div>
